bug_semantics: Authenticated staff using CiviCRM contact Search Builder (operator Regex) reach CRM_Contact_BAO_Query::buildClause with op=RLIKE. The RLIKE arm interpolates the user-supplied $value into CAST($field AS BINARY) RLIKE BINARY '$value' without CRM_Utils_Type::escape / CRM_Core_DAO::escapeString. A quote in the regex breaks the SQL string literal, so the attacker can append arbitrary SQL and read the full database (donor/member records, credentials). Other operators in the same function take the default branch, which does escape. The operator is user-selectable via CRM_Core_SelectValues::getSearchBuilderOperators() ('RLIKE' => Regex) and is exercised by tests/phpunit/CRM/Contact/SelectorTest.php::testWhereClauseByOperator.
flaw_origin: The unsanitized RLIKE interpolation was first written in member commit a047568869892f9af65002c1709af1931f5f4b0d (PR #12364, 'dev/core#210: Regex filter broken in Search Builder', 2018-06-26) as `case 'RLIKE': return " {$clause} BINARY '{$value}' ";`. Immediate parent 8b977676304e1d83f7f8608b87b2065c38de62d3 had no RLIKE special case: RLIKE fell through to default, which called CRM_Utils_Type::escape before quoting. The special case was added to preserve regex case (BINARY) and skipped that escape. Later 0800bc59a47fd6cfe2f4463207e9e47d7a0edfc4 (2021-01-17) only rewrote the same interpolation to CAST({$field} AS BINARY) RLIKE BINARY '{$value}' for MySQL 8; that is a refactor, not a first write.

reasoning: Vulnerability first: CVE-2026-72558/GHSA-h3jq-rqqh-3gvh is a published CWE-89 in CiviCRM contact search RLIKE, not withdrawn/rejected. The sink is CRM_Contact_BAO_Query::buildClause's RLIKE case, which concatenates staff-supplied Search Builder Regex values into SQL without the escape used by every other valued operator. Attack path is authenticated staff (PR:L) choosing Regex on a contact field and injecting a quote to read arbitrary tables. BIC: the smallest first write of that unsanitized interpolation is member a047568869892f9af65002c1709af1931f5f4b0d; parent 8b977676304e1d83f7f8608b87b2065c38de62d3 was checked in-tree and lacks case 'RLIKE', routing RLIKE through escaped default. The 2018 GitHub merge and the 2021 CAST rewrite are not BICs. BIC precedes 6.18.alpha1 and remains in 6.18.alpha1 and HEAD. AI second: commit-object author/committer is human deb.monish/monishdeb with no AI trailers or bot identity, so NOT_AI. potential_fix.approach: In CRM_Contact_BAO_Query::buildClause case 'RLIKE', run $value through CRM_Utils_Type::escape($value, $dataType) (String -> CRM_Core_DAO::escapeString) before wrapping it in the BINARY quotes, or remove the special case so RLIKE uses the existing default escaped path and keep CAST/BINARY only on the field expression.
potential_fix.rationale: That restores quote neutralization already applied to '=', LIKE, and other valued operators, so a staff Regex payload cannot break out of the SQL string while regex semantics remain.
